comment: Edits for chap09.ipynb. Code blocks (code, lstlisting and stdout environments, including ones that only show output) are numbered from 1 in the order they appear in book/chap09.tex. 'after': cells to add after a block (a string of code, {source, raises_exception}, or {markdown}); 'raises_exception': blocks whose cells raise an error on purpose. 'prepend': code to put before a block's code; 'static': blocks shown as text, not run.

19.markdown: *In the browser version of Octave, `legend` with these labels currently hangs (a bug in xeus-octave's graphics), so these two examples are shown but not run here. They work in MATLAB and desktop Octave.*
